description: Compact DefiLlama snapshot of a DeFi protocol: TVL in total and per chain, 1d, 7d and 30d TVL change, market cap, category, audit links, and raise and hack counts, with up to 90 days of daily TVL on request (history_days). Fees and revenue are in compare_protocols. Partial when TVL, category or audits are missing; an unknown slug is an error (HTTP 404). Free tier.

history_days.description: Daily TVL points to include, newest last (0 to 90; default 0, no history).

name: get_defi_protocol
